description: WHICH tickers are having their order flow ABSORBED right now - large flow moving price less than the continuous-tape Kyle-lambda model explains - for a date (default latest): one row per ticker with the absorption strength percentile, the side, the pre-event context and whether it is tradeable (DROP context + Q3/Q4), plus whole-market breadth. row_semantics says whether each row is the day's PEAK event (settled session) or the LATEST one (live). This is an EVENT FEED, not a validated signal: the regime gate is long-only (SPY 63-day return > 0) and fails in bear tapes, auction windows are excluded as mechanical artifacts, and provisional=true means the event was detected live without calibration. Check coverage.completeness before concluding the tape is quiet - a degraded feed looks identical to a calm one. Use for 'who is absorbing selling today?'. Pro.
name: absorption_market
title: Absorption cross-section
